release_provenance.conclusion: The repository evidence does not prove one unique v0.3.0 archive-to-commit chain. Migration reports schema compatibility and marker metadata separately and never claim archive attestation without archive bytes.

implemented_invariants: source SQLite is never opened by SQLite; DB/WAL bytes are copied and re-hashed before the staging-only backup API runs
source and pinned external metadata are inventoried before and after migration
v1 target is built in disposable staging and atomically published
run/event history is immutable diagnostic data, not live replay input
active and queued runs become redacted user-confirmed recovery drafts
legacy scheduler tasks remain disabled pending explicit confirmation
legacy permission grants and paths are not activated
provider and connector credentials remain encrypted in local quarantine
WebUI-only history is imported only when canonical DB history is absent
branch lineage is written only when request ownership and parent identity are provable
malformed queue, scheduler, release marker, schema, ownership or duplicate IDs fail closed
migration failure leaves the v0.3 source and existing target untouched

limitations: No original 551+ MiB v0.3 release archive was downloaded or re-hashed in this local audit.
A release marker digest proves the supplied marker bytes, not the historical package bytes.
Old active work and scheduled work intentionally require user confirmation instead of automatic continuation.
